summary: The PR addresses the ZeroDivisionError by handling the case when support_vectors_ is empty. However, there are some minor issues regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: There are no additional tests specifically added to verify the fix for the ZeroDivisionError when support_vectors_ is empty. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be included.
The PR does not include an update to the docstring or comments to explain the new condition added for handling empty support_vectors_.
